div.div:
Consumer A · the tests
SecureKafkaStack.apply(policy) creates the topics and the ALLOW bindings on a real broker.
The contract first asserts that the principal in the file matches the identity under test.

./gradlew renderKafkaAcls writes build/kafka-acls.args.

div.div:
The setting the whole thing rests on
allow.everyone.if.no.acl.found=false, with the StandardAuthorizer.
An absent grant is a denial, not a pass. Without it the ALLOW list is decoration and every DENY assertion passes vacuously.
